WishEntry.title: WishEntry
WishEntry.description: A 3D sticky-note birthday wish posted on the Birthday Wishes Wall and persisted in Firestore for the logged-in user.

authorUid.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns/views this sticky note

senderName.description: Display name signed on the sticky note

wishText.description: The short birthday message written on the 3D sticky note

stickerEmoji.description: Decorative pin/sticker icon on the sticky note

ChatLogEntry.title: ChatLogEntry
ChatLogEntry.description: Permanent record of a chat exchange between Atrayee and Anik, readable only by Anik.

authorUid.description: UID of the authenticated user who sent the message

authorEmail.description: Verified email address of the authenticated user

userMessage.description: The message sent in the chat

anikReply.description: The short, clear reply from Anik

DailyAffirmationStatus.title: DailyAffirmationStatus
DailyAffirmationStatus.description: A daily heartfelt affirmation from Anik to his sister persisted with a Read status in Firestore.

authorUid.description: UID of the authenticated user who read the daily affirmation

dateKey.description: YYYY-MM-DD calendar date key for the daily affirmation

affirmationTitle.description: Title of the heartfelt sibling affirmation

affirmationText.description: Heartfelt message from Anik to his sister

status.description: Persisted read status of the affirmation

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when marked as Read

MemoryLikeCount.title: MemoryLikeCount
MemoryLikeCount.description: Persisted likes counter for a specific memory card in the TimelineSection.

authorUid.description: UID of the authenticated user who liked the memory

memoryId.description: Identifier of the memory card in Memory Lane

likes.description: Total number of heart likes given to this memory card

/wishes/{wishId}.description: 3D sticky-note birthday wishes persisted in Firestore specifically for the logged-in user

/chatLogs/{logId}.description: Permanent append-only chat archive where Atrayee can create logs on send, but cannot read, update, or delete them

/dailyAffirmations/{affirmationDocId}.description: Daily heartfelt affirmations from Anik persisted with a Read status in Firestore

/memoryLikes/{likeDocId}.description: Persisted heart likes counter for each memory card in the TimelineSection
